name: Legs Up Wall

frames.label: Prepare
frames.cue: Sit sideways with one hip close to the wall.

frames.label: Lower and Turn
frames.cue: Lower onto your back and bring your feet onto the wall.

frames.label: Legs Up
frames.cue: Straighten your legs comfortably up the wall.

frames.label: Hold
frames.cue: Relax your shoulders, soften your knees and remain comfortable.

frames.label: Bend Knees Exit
frames.cue: Bend your knees and roll gently to one side.

frames.label: Recovery
frames.cue: Return slowly to a comfortable seated position.

safety: Keep the hips a comfortable distance from the wall; move farther away if the hamstrings pull.
Keep a soft bend in the knees and avoid forcing the legs straight.
Exit slowly if there is dizziness, numbness, tingling, back pain or increased eye pressure discomfort.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did Legs Up Wall feel? Note hamstring tension, back comfort, tingling or dizziness.
